sn22.9:1.2: “Bhikkhus, form is impermanent, both of the past and the future,
sn22.9:1.3: not to speak of the present.
sn22.9:1.4: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards form of the past;
sn22.9:1.5: he does not seek delight in form of the future;
sn22.9:1.6: and he is practising for revulsion towards form of the present, for its fading away and cessation.
sn22.9:1.14: Consciousness is impermanent, both of the past and the future,
sn22.9:1.15: not to speak of the present.
sn22.9:1.16: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards consciousness of the past;
sn22.9:1.17: he does not seek delight in consciousness of the future;
sn22.9:1.18: and he is practising for revulsion towards consciousness of the present, for its fading away and cessation.”
